name: Tomato cup
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida) (57%), edible vegetable oil (palmolein oil) (26%), corn starch (6.5%), sugar, edible common salt, vegetables powder (tomato (0.8%), garlic, onion), spices & condiments (red chilli, cumin, clove, cinnamon), flavour enhancer (INS 635), anticaking agent (INS 551), (INS 341(i)), raising agent (INS 500(ii), INS 500(i)), flour treatment agent (INS 170(i)), natural & nature identical flavouring substances (tomato flavour), acidity regulator (INS 334), (INS 330), (INS 296), (INS 262) and colour (INS 160c(ii)).
